solution_quarantine.method: Removed the level-two solution section through the next level-two heading or EOF before inspection.

synquid.reason_not_attempted: A sound full contract cannot be expressed with the pinned runtime's available list measures/set refinements. Running a weak set/length-only contract would violate the benchmark rule against calling incomplete contracts.

required_features: A multiplicity-preserving bag/multiset relation over complete inner lists, not merely a Set relation.
A way to count how many elements of an outer list have a given derived key (inner-list length).
A relation linking every output inner list to its input multiplicity while allowing an unspecified permutation within equal-key blocks.
Quantified or inductively defined monotonicity over those input-derived frequency keys.
semantic_obligations: length_sort: preserve every inner list and its multiplicity; order inner-list lengths nondecreasingly.
frequency_sort: preserve every inner list and its multiplicity; order by nondecreasing frequency of the inner-list length in the original input.
Accept finite empty/repeated nested lists and remain polymorphic in elements.
Do not impose an unstated tie-break or stability requirement.

tie_order.benchmark_interpretation: Any permutation whose required sort key is nondecreasing is valid.

checks: Official displayed examples as valid semantic illustrations.
Candidate nondecreasing length or input-frequency key.
341 exhaustive outer inputs built from four representative inner lists, at outer lengths 0 through 4.
An explicit drop-all negative control rejected by the same permutation assertion.
